name: Live Alert: PM-KISAN 15th Installment Update
description: Scraped Alert: e-KYC is mandatory for the upcoming installment. Please visit your nearest CSC.
apply: Complete e-KYC on the PM-KISAN portal or CSC.

name: Live Update: PM-AASHA (Annadata Aay SanraksHan Abhiyan)
description: Scraped from MyScheme: The government has announced extended procurement operations for pulse and oilseed farmers under the Price Support Scheme (PSS).
eligibility: Farmers registered on the state procurement portals growing pulses, oilseeds, and copra.
apply: Contact your local APMC or state procurement agency.

name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Direct income support of Rs. 6,000 per year, paid in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 every four months, transferred directly to bank accounts
eligibility: All landholding farmer families, subject to exclusion criteria for higher-income categories (e.g. income tax payers, institutional landholders)
apply: Register via pmkisan.gov.in, or through Common Service Centres (CSCs); requires Aadhaar and land records
source: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India

name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
description: Crop insurance scheme covering yield losses due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases; farmer premium is capped at 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops
eligibility: All farmers, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers, growing notified crops in notified areas
apply: Enroll through banks, Common Service Centres, insurance company portals, or the national crop insurance portal, before the cut-off date each season
source: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Provides farmers with a report on the nutrient status of their soil along with fertilizer and soil amendment recommendations, issued once every 2 years per landholding
apply: Soil samples collected by the local Agriculture Department or Krishi Vigyan Kendra; cards distributed accordingly
source: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
description: Provides short-term credit for cultivation and allied needs at subsidized interest rates (effective rate as low as 4% per annum for prompt repayment under interest subvention)
eligibility: Farmers, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, and self-help group members involved in agriculture or allied activities
apply: Apply at any public/private sector bank, Regional Rural Bank, or cooperative bank with land records and identity proof
source: NABARD / Reserve Bank of India, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
description: Provides financial assistance for purchase of farm machinery and equipment, and for setting up Custom Hiring Centres; subsidy typically ranges 40-50% for small/marginal farmers depending on the equipment and state guidelines
eligibility: Individual farmers (priority to small, marginal, women, SC/ST farmers), farmer producer organizations, and cooperatives
apply: Apply through the state Agriculture Department or the Direct Benefit Transfer in Agriculture Mechanization (DBT) portal for the respective state
source: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
